name: Clip-wide noise sliced per chunk
plain: Chunked video rendering usually reseeds per chunk, so the overlap holds two unrelated noises for the same moment. This asks the NOISE object for one tensor for the whole clip's length, then gives each chunk its slice, so neighbours start with identical noise in their overlap. The docstring says this is what stops double exposure in the cross-fade.
math:
ε_clip = noise.generate_noise(zero NestedTensor of [total video tokens, total audio tokens]).
chunk noise = ε_clip[overlap-consistent slice] for each stream.

evidence.symbol: chunk_noise = noise_tensor if noise_tensor is not None
